hints.title: Linear Suffix Identification
hints.text: Identify the start index of the lexicographically largest suffix in linear time.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Scanning
hints.text: Maintain two pointer candidates and advance the inferior prefix upon first character divergence.

hints.title: Length Truncation
hints.text: Truncate the maximal suffix at n - numFriends + 1 characters to ensure all other friends receive non-empty pieces.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear time two-pointer scan locates maximal suffix followed by length truncation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic substring comparisons time out for n up to 2 * 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space to extract the truncated result string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Solves maximum suffix in linear time using two pointers and caps length by constraints.
